title: Homepage content (canonical v2, additive)
description: Contract for wordpress/themes/<theme>/content/pages/home.json. Unlike a location or service file this one is ADDITIVE, not a replacement: front-page.php keeps its frozen section order and renders these sections into it. The homepage is the primary city's page, so it must never become a second location page — it has no city/state, and the intent for the primary city stays at '/'. See docs/architecture/content-schema.md.

seo_title.description: Optional override for seo.home_title in business-config.php. Omit to keep the configured one.

seo_description.description: Optional override for seo.home_description in business-config.php.

sections.description: Rendered after the intro-content section and before 'What We Buy', so the page's own long-form prose sits where a reader arrives at it, and every configured homepage component below stays in place.
